name: orca-docket
description: Reviewer-agnostic findings resolution for coding agents, with an Orca panel.

scripts.build: pnpm run gen && tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm run bundle
scripts.check: pnpm run gen && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run spec:validate && pnpm run bundle && pnpm run test:bundle && claude plugin validate ./plugin && claude plugin validate . && git diff --exit-code -- src/schemas.generated.ts plugin/bin/docket.cjs
